verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. لِدَاوُدَ قَالَ ٱلْجَاهِلُ فِي قَلْبِهِ: «لَيْسَ إِلَهٌ». فَسَدُوا وَرَجِسُوا بِأَفْعَالِهِمْ. لَيْسَ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ صَلَاحًا.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David. The fool hath said in his heart, [There is] no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, [there is] none that doeth good.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.
verses.he: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָ֫וִ֥ד אָ֘מַ֤ר נָבָ֣ל בְּ֭לִבֹּו אֵ֣ין אֱלֹהִ֑ים הִֽשְׁחִ֗יתוּ הִֽתְעִ֥יבוּ עֲלִילָ֗ה אֵ֣ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֹֽוב׃

verses.ar: اَلرَّبُّ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ أَشْرَفَ عَلَى بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ، لِيَنْظُرَ: هَلْ مِنْ فَاهِمٍ طَالِبِ ٱللهِ؟
verses.kjv: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, [and] seek God.
verses.web: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.
verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה מִשָּׁמַיִם֮ הִשְׁקִ֪יף עַֽל־בְּנֵי־אָ֫דָ֥ם לִ֭רְאֹות הֲיֵ֣שׁ מַשְׂכִּ֑יל דֹּ֝רֵשׁ אֶת־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

verses.ar: ٱلْكُلُّ قَدْ زَاغُوا مَعًا، فَسَدُوا. لَيْسَ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ صَلَاحًا، لَيْسَ وَلَا وَاحِدٌ.
verses.kjv: They are all gone aside, they are [all] together become filthy: [there is] none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.web: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.
verses.he: הַכֹּ֥ל סָר֮ יַחְדָּ֪ו נֶ֫אֱלָ֥חוּ אֵ֤ין עֹֽשֵׂה־טֹ֑וב אֵ֝֗ין גַּם־אֶחָֽד׃

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ كُلُّ فَاعِلِي ٱلْإِثْمِ، ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْكُلُونَ شَعْبِي كَمَا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلْخُبْزَ، وَٱلرَّبَّ لَمْ يَدْعُوا.
verses.kjv: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people [as] they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
verses.web: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on Yahweh?
verses.he: הֲלֹ֥א יָדְעוּ֮ כָּל־פֹּ֪עֲלֵ֫י אָ֥וֶן אֹכְלֵ֣י עַ֭מִּי אָ֣כְלוּ לֶ֑חֶם יְ֝הוָ֗ה לֹ֣א קָרָֽאוּ׃

verses.ar: هُنَاكَ خَافُوا خَوْفًا، لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ فِي ٱلْجِيلِ ٱلْبَارِّ.
verses.kjv: There were they in great fear: for God [is] in the generation of the righteous.
verses.web: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.
verses.he: שָׁ֤ם ׀ פָּ֣חֲדוּ פָ֑חַד כִּֽי־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים בְּדֹ֣ור צַדִּֽיק׃

verses.ar: رَأْيَ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ نَاقَضْتُمْ، لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ مَلْجَأُهُ.
verses.kjv: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD [is] his refuge.
verses.web: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because Yahweh is his refuge.

verses.ar: لَيْتَ مِنْ صِهْيَوْنَ خَلَاصَ إِسْرَائِيلَ. عِنْدَ رَدِّ ٱلرَّبِّ سَبْيَ شَعْبِهِ، يَهْتِفُ يَعْقُوبُ، وَيَفْرَحُ إِسْرَائِيلُ.
verses.kjv: Oh that the salvation of Israel [were come] out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.
verses.web: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When Yahweh restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.
verses.he: מִ֥י יִתֵּ֣ן מִצִּיֹּון֮ יְשׁוּעַ֪ת יִשְׂרָ֫אֵ֥ל בְּשׁ֣וּב יְ֭הוָה שְׁב֣וּת עַמֹּ֑ו יָגֵ֥ל יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב יִשְׂמַ֥ח יִשְׂרֽ͏ָאֵל׃
